newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Rugby union-Hurricanes play down rumours of Cullen switch.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Hurricanes play down rumours of Cullen switch.

text.p: Wellington coach Frank Oliver has dampened speculation fullback Christian Cullen will switch to the centres for the Super 12 semifinal against ACT Brumbies on Saturday.
Winger Alex Telea has already been ruled out with a knee injury and there are rumours Oliver is considering moving All Black international Cullen into midfield in a further change.
Asked about the rumours, Oliver said: "Christian has played centres for me before, but I don't know where that (speculation) came from."
If Cullen is moved, reserve Jarrod Cunningham is almost certain to play at fullback, while winger Roger Randle has been drafted into the squad to replace Telea.
The Hurricanes have arrived in Canberra to prepare for the encounter with the Brumbies at Bruce Stadium.
ACT earned the right to host the semifinal by beating Wellington 38-29 in New Zealand on Sunday.
Auckland will face Natal in the other semifinal this weekend.
